The permission key list was read from the OpenCode agents doc on 2026-10-19 and ends in '...', so it stays complete false: the permission row is REVIEW and never PASS (gates.md G3). Unit B1 (D6): glob, grep and list grant the search capability; read and lsp grant read. Unit B2 (D3, D5, D6, D7): models.judgment.model is null until pinesky names a provider and model before E1, so the generated wrapper omits model (gates.md G29). permissions.wildcard is the key a generated map puts first with deny, and permissions.pattern_keys the only keys that take a pattern map, whose first entry is the wildcard and whose other entries must deny. render.bash_deny is the bash deny list of a shell-capable generated wrapper (plan.md:966). OpenCode's pattern syntax, its wildcard and last-match-wins semantics and the read and .env interplay are UNVERIFIED (plan.md:967, gates.md G31), the user-scope install command does not exist before B6, and any pattern can be bypassed through python3 -c (Appendix C R14), so the list is a second layer behind the H1 signature.
